system.description:
After a successful Strike, roll the Strike's Dice Pool again. The enemy gains Bleed (X), where X is the number of Smarts symbols in that second roll.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.46
system.summary: After a successful Strike, roll the Strike's Dice Pool again. The enemy gains Bleed (X), where X is the number of Smarts symbols in that second roll.

automation.note: After each successful Strike, re-roll the same Dice Pool and count Smarts symbols (Talent stars count): the enemy gains Bleed of that value.
